patch.value: GH-827: local package install must prevent recursive self-copy and disk exhaustion

Installing a local package whose tracker and extension destination are inside the source recursively copies the destination and backups into themselves, including node_modules, while reporting success.

Install rejects or safely prunes destination-inside-source; tracker roots, backups, and node_modules cannot enter installed copies; repeated-install acceptance proves bounded size; failures never report ok true
Make the normal local package development install loop bounded and containment-safe
Package authors cannot exhaust disks by repeatedly installing their own checkout
Prevents exponential storage growth and ENOSPC failures in standard package layouts
